name: GCW Rise to Glory, 2 August 1999

matches.note: Main event, GCW Glory Championship; a disputed near-fall pinned Hussar for the standing referee's three-count [GCW Glory Championship]

appearances.source: Presented as the new GCW Southern Heritage Champion by the promotion's own ring announcer, recapping in his own words a title win the week before.

notes: The promotion's own broadcast, headlined by the GCW Glory Championship changing hands in a contested main event and opened by the ring announcement of a new GCW Southern Heritage Champion recapping a title win the week before.
